remarks: Conveniently located, set back from Danbury Road on a private driveway. This sun-filled updated Colonial offers 4 Bedrooms and 4 full baths. First floor offers a chef Kitchen with professional grade appliances, granite counters, custom cabinetry and slider leading to a large Deck for outdoor entertaining, Dining Room, Living Room and Family Room with fireplace, new hardwood floors throughout. Mud Room with full Bath and Laundry located off the 3-car garage. Upstairs, Large Primary Bedroom with ensuite and double walk-in closets. In close proximity are two Bedrooms and a hall Bath. Another large Bedroom with full Bath is connected yet separate from the Primary which allows for an in-law suite possibility. All this located on 1.27 professional landscaped acres with room for a pool. Move-in ready, A must see.
